id: 197_焊机部件更换（二）：控制与气路部件
title: 焊机部件更换（二）：控制与气路部件
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/197_焊机部件更换（二）：控制与气路部件.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/197_焊机部件更换（二）：控制与气路部件/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块主控板和一个气动阀组件
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a control circuit board in one hand and a small pneumatic valve assembly in the other, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第三十五课：焊机部件更换（二）。
overlay: 焊机部件更换（二）：控制与气路部件

shots.scene: 屏幕不亮，阿杰想把主板拔下来看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a dark blank screen on a welder and reaches toward its side panel, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：屏幕不亮？拔主板看看！

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs an out of service tag on the welder and points at a phone icon.
shots.narration: 小研：挂牌停用，报设备负责人。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on an antistatic wrist strap beside an unplugged welder, a flow chart icon behind him.
shots.narration: 老李：还是那套通用流程。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an equipment manager badge and a service engineer badge beside an open welder cabinet, a student icon outside the line. No text.
shots.narration: 控制和气路部件，也只由授权人员换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the gas cylinder valve and the compressed air valve closed, both gauges falling to zero. No text.
shots.narration: 换气动组件前，关气源、泄压归零。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an antistatic wrist strap clipped to the chassis earth point before touching a circuit board. No text.
shots.narration: 碰电路板前，戴好防静电腕带。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀、内六角、镊子、撬棒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tool tray with cross head screwdrivers of two sizes, hex keys, tweezers, a plastic pry tool, scissors and cable ties. No text.
shots.narration: 按部件备好螺丝刀、内六角、镊子。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a micro screwdriver bit matched to a small screw head, a wrong bit slipping and stripping the screw crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 小螺钉批头选对型号，免得滑丝。

shots.scene: 新板先查包装、外观、规格
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new circuit board checked for intact packaging, no cracks, straight pins and a matching label icon, a cracked board crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 新板到货查外观和规格，有损不装。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welder switched off, the power plug and all cables removed. No text.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉电源插头和全部线缆。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: all four caster brakes pressed down. No text.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住，不会滑动。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unplugged welder with a clock and a discharge arrow, a manual icon. No text.
shots.narration: 按说明书静置，放电、冷却。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand holding a handle while the last screw is removed, a falling handle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拆把手侧板，最后一颗扶住。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the earth wire unscrewed and the mounting plate laid flat, the control board area visible. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下接地线，放平安装板。

shots.scene: 螺丝分格放，手在下方护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: screws placed into separate compartments of a parts box, a hand cupped below a screw being removed, a screw falling between circuits crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 螺丝分格放，取时手在下方护着。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: foam pads on the floor and two people laying the heavy welder on its side onto the pads. No text.
shots.narration: 要拆底部，侧放前先垫软垫。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two people holding the welder at both ends, lowering it slowly, a single person tipping it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 机器很重，两人扶着慢慢放。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bottom screws refitted, then two people standing the welder upright again. No text.
shots.narration: 装回底部螺钉，再两人扶正。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of side cutters snipping a cable tie inside an unplugged welder with the blade turned away from nearby wires.
shots.narration: 剪扎带时，别剪到旁边的线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cut cable tie ends collected into a small cup, a tie end falling into a fan crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 剪下的断头马上收走，免得卡风扇。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tweezers peeling a dab of fixing glue off a connector, the glue bits collected. No text.
shots.narration: 插头有固定胶，先用镊子剥掉。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers gripping a connector body and pulling it straight off a training circuit board, not pulling the wires.
shots.narration: 捏住插头拔，不扯导线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a connector latch and a keyed shape matched with the socket, a reversed plug with smoke crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 看清卡扣和方向，插反会烧坏。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a main control board in the electrical area connected to the screen, power supplies, wire feeder and torch by many plugs. No text.
shots.narration: 主控板是大脑，连着屏幕和各部件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plug position picture beside the board, plugs removed one by one in order. No text.
shots.narration: 对照位置图，逐个拔下插头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the old board held by its edges, lifted out and placed into an antistatic bag. No text.
shots.narration: 捏住板边取下，旧板装袋放好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each plug matched to its socket by shape and pushed fully home, a mismatched plug forced in crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 插头按形状对准插回，别硬插。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a touch display screen on the front panel of the welder with a protective film and a ribbon cable behind. No text.
shots.narration: 显示屏在前面板，背后接排线。

shots.scene: 【实拍】塑料撬棒撬四角，向外用力
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a plastic pry tool lifting the corner of a protective film on a powered off display, pushing away from the other hand.
shots.narration: 用塑料撬棒，向外用力撬四角。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal knife scratching the screen and touching a circuit crossed out, a plastic pry tool checked. No text.
shots.narration: 不用金属刀，会划屏碰电路。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the new screen placed in its bracket with the ribbon cable aligned to the notch and reconnected. No text.
shots.narration: 新屏入支架，排线对准缺口接好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new protective film aligned at four corners and smoothed from the centre outward. No text.
shots.narration: 新保护膜对齐四角，从中间抹平。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torch communication cable running inside the spring and black sheath of the welding torch cable from the torch board to the main board. No text.
shots.narration: 焊枪通信线在线缆护套里。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the torch removed and its cable laid in a large loop, a sharp bend crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 取下焊枪，线缆保持弧度不急弯。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers loosening a cable clip on the torch cable sheath and inserting a paper clip to mark its position.
shots.narration: 松开线卡，回形针做记号。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the new cable threaded through the spring and fully enclosed by the sheath, both ends plugged into the torch board and the main board. No text.
shots.narration: 新线穿弹簧，护套完全包住。

shots.scene: 按记号拧紧，回形针取完
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clips tightened at the paper clip marks, all paper clips counted and removed. No text.
shots.narration: 按记号拧紧线卡，回形针全取下。

shots.scene: 安全继电器：监视急停和联锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety relay on a rail linked to the emergency stop button and the interlock, cutting the laser enable when either opens. No text.
shots.narration: 安全继电器监视急停和联锁。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the relay component plate taken out of the cabinet onto a bench, the relay slid off its rail. No text.
shots.narration: 整块组件取出，在台面上换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wire number tags matched to terminal marks on the new relay, each wire tightened and tugged. No text.
shots.narration: 接线线号对准端子标记，逐根轻拉。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: contactor wires reconnected in the order of the reference picture, cables to the main board plugged back. No text.
shots.narration: 接触器线序对图，线束扎整齐。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pneumatic assembly with a solenoid valve and a pressure sensor controlling the shielding gas to the torch. No text.
shots.narration: 气动组件用电磁阀控制保护气。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers pressing the release collar of a push in fitting and pulling out a blue air hose on a depressurised assembly.
shots.narration: 按住卡套再拔气管，不硬拽。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sensor and solenoid valve wires unplugged from the main board, the old assembly lifted out. No text.
shots.narration: 拔下传感器和电磁阀的线。

shots.scene: 新组件穿线，气管插到底
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the new assembly wires routed from right to left to the main board, the hoses pushed fully into the fittings. No text.
shots.narration: 新组件按原路穿线，气管插到底。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a yellow optical fibre inside the cabinet kept in its original gentle curve, a sharp kink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 黄色光纤别弯折，保持原弧度。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fibre clamp loosened during work and the fibre fixing block refitted afterward. No text.
shots.narration: 光纤夹松开后，要装回固定好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fibre and air hoses fixed in place, cables tidied with cable ties. No text.
shots.narration: 光纤、气管固定到位，线缆扎好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cables tucked back into the cabinet clear of the cover edge, a cable pinched by the cover crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 线缆收回机内，不被盖板压住。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: side cover hooks aligned with pins and pushed in, the torch cable wound back onto its hanger. No text.
shots.narration: 盖板挂钩对销钉，焊枪挂回挂架。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand shaking a refitted handle on a powered off welder to check it does not wobble.
shots.narration: 把手拧紧，摇一摇不晃才搬运。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a flashlight beam sweeping inside an open unplugged welder cabinet checking for left screws and tie ends.
shots.narration: 装盖前手电照一遍，无遗留物。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tools in the tray matched to their outlines, the parts box empty of spare screws, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 工具零件点齐，一件不落。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the emergency stop pressed during a test and all outputs stopping, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 修完先测急停是否有效。

shots.scene: 再测联锁：断开不能出光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an interlock opened and the laser enable blocked, crossed laser rays, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 再测联锁：断开时不能出光。

shots.scene: 试机：枪口对挡板，戴眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the torch fixed in its holder aimed at a metal shield, the tester wearing laser safety glasses, others standing back. No text.
shots.narration: 试机枪口对挡板，戴好防护镜。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with emergency stop, interlock, gas and display all ticked, then the out of service tag removed. No text.
shots.narration: 全部正常，才能恢复使用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank touch screen showing all parameter areas lit, a missing area crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 换屏后先看参数显示全不全。

shots.scene: 触摸灵不灵，报警弹不弹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger tapping the screen with a response icon, an alarm icon popping up during a test. No text.
shots.narration: 触摸灵不灵，报警能不能弹出。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the parameter set compared with the recorded original values, a lock icon, a changed value crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 换屏换板不改参数，以原设定为准。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands the repaired welder back to the female graduate student, pointing at a repair log.
shots.narration: 修好移交，告诉使用人换了什么。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a first use with an eye icon watching for alarms, an alarm leading to stop and a call to the facility engineer. No text.
shots.narration: 首用多留意，再报警马上停机。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spare board in its original antistatic package on a dry shelf, the old board bagged and labelled for return or recycling. No text.
shots.narration: 备件原包装干燥放，旧板按规定回收。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons for main control board, display, torch communication cable, safety relay and pneumatic assembly. No text.
shots.narration: 认清主板、屏、线缆、继电器、气动件。

shots.scene: 防静电、捏插头、光纤不弯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrist strap, a fingers on connector icon and a gently curved fibre. No text.
shots.narration: 防静电，捏插头，光纤不弯折。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: emergency stop and interlock test icons with checks, then a handover icon. No text.
shots.narration: 先测急停联锁，正常再移交。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of chapter icons, safety management, chemicals, biology, radiation, electricity, laser, machinery, gas cylinders, emergency response and lab skills, joined by one path. No text.
shots.narration: 从安全管理到实验技能，课程学完了。

shots.scene: 欣欣和全体角色站在实验室门口，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with the female graduate student, the young male student, the older man, the safety administrator, the facility engineer and the security officer at a laboratory entrance, all wearing proper protection and waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 安全第一，每一次实验都平安！
